```plato
    // A vector whose i-th component is f applied to the i-th components of a and
    // b. Precondition: a and b have the same arity.
    ZipComponents(a: IVector, b: IVector, f: Function2<Number, Number, Number>): IVector
        => a.FromComponents(a.ComponentArray.Zip(b.ComponentArray, f));
```
